geometry.name: Manila Bay
geometry.useDecision: Exploratory named-bay query filter only. This is not a NAMRIA/LGU boundary, a municipal-water boundary, a fishing-ground boundary, or an app navigation/legal geometry.

terms.statement: Marine Regions states CC-BY for its products, asks users to link to the current source, and limits intended use to scientific, educational and research purposes; it says its data has no legal value and is not for legal, economic-resource or navigation use.

query.queryGeometryMethod: Use the Marine Regions polygon bounding box for the OBIS query, then exact-filter returned point coordinates against the unmodified Marine Regions multipolygon in OGC:CRS84.

exactGeometryFilter.method: point-in-multipolygon ray casting; boundary tolerance 1e-10 degrees; no topology repair or simplification

query.interpretation: The 539 scientificName strings and 479 values in the OBIS species field are not validated unique-species totals. These are historical marine occurrence candidates selected with a broad named-bay geometry, not confirmed current presence, abundance, catchability, diet, safety, fishing legality, or municipal-water presence.

datasetTriage.decision: Each contributing dataset carries its own license and scope. The API result has no single result-wide reuse permission. Dataset metadata is only a first rights review; inspect each retained occurrence and original archive before any public reuse.

highPriorityDatasetReview.title: CAS Ichthyology (ICH)
highPriorityDatasetReview.metadataCaveat: This is the CAS electronic ichthyology collection. Broad locality strings and coarse coordinates do not establish exact Cavite capture sites or current presence.
highPriorityDatasetReview.decision: CC0 source lead for a later record-level historical review; do not add the 610 rows or 356 name strings to app evidence from this query alone.

limits: Marine Regions MRGID 31579 is a named Manila Bay polygon, not an official Cavite or municipal-water boundary; the Gazetteer record identifies GeoNames as the place-name source and Marine Regions as geometry provenance.

Marine Regions terms restrict intended use to scientific, educational and research uses and disclaim legal value. Do not expose this geometry as a fishing, navigation, legal or municipal-water boundary in Bangwit.

The bbox includes points outside the bay polygon; only the 1,874 exact-filter matches were counted inside this named-bay geometry. The ray-casting implementation was used for discovery and is not a full topology validation.
OBIS quality flags may overlap and include missing depth, location, bathymetry and taxonomic issues; they require record-level interpretation.
The CAS subset is historic (1900-1969); 160 locality strings include Cavite but have a median coordinate uncertainty of 45,341 m, and only 24 of those rows have a year value.
Dataset licenses vary. No record-level original archive, current-presence, legal boundary, abundance, catchability, diet or safety conclusion is made.
OBIS is a marine biodiversity source and does not cover the regional freshwater checklist needed for rivers, lakes and reservoirs.
nextActions: Continue record-level review of the CC0 CAS candidate subset, retaining original locality/date and OBIS quality flags; only admit a small historical Manila Bay assertion if an explicit criterion is met.
Keep seeking an authoritative Cavite municipal-water or other fit-for-purpose boundary independently; do not infer it from this bay polygon.
Continue separate inland-water source work for CALABARZON before advancing to NCR.
